Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic, Ajmer

Our Ajmer clinic, in the Oasis Complex at Shastri Nagar, is led by oral and maxillofacial surgeon Dr. Aliza Rizvi, together with Dr. Dhiral Vijayvargiya. It focuses on hair transplant, hair-loss diagnosis and facial aesthetics.

FAQs

Visiting our Ajmer clinic

What are the timings of Kezza Clinic Ajmer?
The Ajmer clinic is open from 9 AM to 8 PM, all 7 days a week, including Sundays. Booking ahead by phone or WhatsApp makes sure the right doctor is available when you arrive.
Where is Kezza Clinic in Ajmer?
1st Floor, Oasis Complex & Hotels, Shastri Nagar, Jawahar Nagar, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305001. The clinic is on the first floor of the Oasis Complex (Hotel Oasis building) in Shastri Nagar, Jawahar Nagar, Ajmer. Use Google Maps directions to reach the door.
Which doctors see patients at the Ajmer clinic?
Dr. Aliza Rizvi, Dr. Dhiral Vijayvargiya. See their qualifications and experience on our doctors page.
How do I book an appointment at the Ajmer clinic?
Call +91 92160 88257, message us on WhatsApp, or use the form on our contact page. Share your concern and a preferred time, and the team will confirm your slot.
Can I get a hair transplant at the Ajmer clinic?
Yes. The Ajmer clinic offers hair transplant consultations and procedures. Your doctor first checks your donor area and hair-loss stage, then explains the plan. Read about hair transplant at Kezza.
